newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips in slight gain; Nasdaq off. [CORRECTED 22:30 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Blue chips in slight gain; Nasdaq off. [CORRECTED 22:30 GMT]

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended with small gains on Monday, pushing the Dow Jones industrial average to another record as investors awaited a series of key economic reports due later this week.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 7.67 points to close at 8,121.11, after earlier rising nearly 65 points. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by a narrow margin on moderate volume of about 468 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The record for the 30-share Dow was its fourth in the last five (corrects from six) sessions.
